title: A Rainy Day
text:
Today it is cold and rainy. Maria puts on her warm coat and her green boots. She takes a red umbrella, too. Her hat is blue, and her gloves are black.

After lunch, the sun comes out. Maria takes off her coat and walks to the park. She is happy because the weather is nice now. She does not need her gloves anymore.

questions.text: Where does Maria walk after lunch?
Why does Maria take off her coat after lunch?
How does the weather change during the day?

vocabulary.definition: a long piece of clothing worn outside to keep warm
an object you hold over your head to stay dry in the rain
clothing for the hands that keeps them warm

paragraph_translations: Hoy hace frío y llueve. Maria se pone su abrigo cálido y sus botas verdes. También toma un paraguas rojo. Su sombrero es azul y sus guantes son negros.
Después del almuerzo, sale el sol. Maria se quita el abrigo y camina al parque. Está feliz porque ahora hace buen tiempo. Ya no necesita sus guantes.
